links.outcome: Change in specificity and balanced accuracy after Youden-index threshold optimization versus conventional threshold
links.effect: Optimal cut-off 0.23 raised specificity from 29.0% to 82.3% and balanced accuracy from 61.1% to 65.6%, without changing the algorithms.
links.quote: The ideal cut-off discovered by threshold optimization was 0.23, raising specificity from 29.0% to 82.3% and balanced accuracy from 61.1% to 65.6%.

links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) of logistic regression versus decision tree and neural network
links.effect: Logistic regression AUC 0.697 vs decision tree 0.654 and neural network 0.654; differences not statistically significant by DeLong's test.
links.quote: Logistic regression achieved the highest discrimination (AUC 0.697), followed by decision tree (AUC 0.654) and neural network (AUC 0.654) models, although differences were not statistically significant according to DeLong’s test.

unlisted_practices: Prefer simpler, interpretable logistic regression over complex ML models when performance is comparable
